Hello! I love your art so much and I was hoping to get an art from you for my birthday, as a little gift to myself! I would still love a piece from you.

My VTuber character is a young goddess-in-training who descended to the human realm to learn more about humans. 

• She has a bright personality and can be mischievous, but is very caring. 
• Please draw her with some alcohol and (optional) a large white snake.
• A starry and magical theme would be perfect.
• Please draw her with a soft and gentle feeling. I will leave the rest of the composition and pose up to you!
• You can either draw her default outfit, or draw her in a hanfu. Please make her hair very long if she is in a hanfu!
• Please pay special attention to her red eyeliner and beauty marks (below the eye and on the side of her chin; see reference).
